Peer Assessment Rubric

  • CollateX Pipeline Execution (4 pts): The submission successfully runs CollateX, producing an accurate alignment table across all three input witnesses without tokenization crashes.
  • Alignment Evaluation & Diagnostics (3 pts): The author astutely diagnoses how the algorithm resolved complex spots (such as transpositions or lacunae) and notes any needed editorial overrides.
  • Stemmatic Reflection (3 pts): The 300–500 word report demonstrates a mature understanding of variant taxonomy, clearly separating substantive genealogical errors from trivial orthographic noise.
